steps.content: Creak... Clang... Scrrrch...

The coffin ghost never looks back, only a relentless sprint forward. Its claws strike the ground like iron hooves, each impact sending a low tremor shuddering through the earth. On the coffin board strapped to its back, faint runes writhe and ripple in the dappled light.

The ground beneath you appears deceptively solid and flat, yet every step you take sinks into a wet, sucking mire. It slows your progress, a sickening familiarity to it—a phantom pain from Maria City. Could the boundaries between the Realm of Yang and the Void of Yin have warped and merged again?
Once more, that cold, dark voice echoes from the depths of your mind:

steps.speaker: Shin?
steps.content: Fragile minds trace and retrace boundaries... but boundaries are just cages the weak build for themselves...

steps.speaker: Shin?
steps.content: Cast off fear. Transcend limits. Then, reach the end you seek. And see what's been hidden all along...
You refuse to dwell on those words any longer. Gritting your teeth, you call out to the coffin ghost.
You don't have to run! I'm not your enemy! I just want to confirm something with you—
The coffin ghost hesitates. Its footsteps falter, and it begins to turn.
Then, they strike.
Shadows launch from Lichen's gourd—paper figures, springing to life.
You snatch one from the air. It writhes in your grip. A crimson gash splits open across its face like a mouth, and it clamps down hard on the webbing between your thumb and forefinger.
Mmph—!
At the sharp pain, you fling it away. Your skin is unbroken, but the sting pulses with sickening reality.
More of them cling to the coffin ghost like a swarm of leeches, shrieking as they tear into it with frenzied hunger.
No! Stop!
The ground writhes beneath you, gripping your ankles, pulling you down. You fight to tear free. Ahead, the coffin ghost buckles, its spine bending...

steps.speaker: Shin?
steps.content: Twist. Merge. Reshape. Yes... yes... To be bound by form is to never taste that supreme sweetness...

steps.speaker: Coffin Ghost
steps.content: Ngh... Ahhh...
...Until, with an agonized howl, it snaps.
A gale of fury explodes outward. Mad with pain, the monstrosity swings its iron chains wildly, friend and foe forgotten.
You dive. A strike clips past you, smashing the earth into a deep crater where you just stood.
The near miss is enough. Lichen's gifts ignite. Talismans and implements rocket from your body in a blinding cascade, hurling themselves at the shrieking ghost.

steps.speaker: Coffin Ghost
steps.content: AAARRGHH!
It meets the assault head-on. Crimson flame blooms across its form, consuming it. It charges toward you, then a leap—
[Red Flash, Add Phantom Effect After This Line]
And it hangs, suspended mid-lunge, as if something has caught it by the throat.
Below, the ground has given birth to something dark. Arms of black mire coil around the coffin ghost's legs, anchoring it.
The sludge stretches, thinning grotesquely as the ghost thrashes. Within that straining darkness, you swear you hear it: ghostly wailing, muffled moans. Yet the grip holds, relentless and iron.
...Could this be Lichen's doing as well?
The hesitation costs you. The coffin ghost whirls its arm, iron chains screaming toward your face—
You brace for impact, knowing you won't make it. Instead, your body folds in a sharp drop that shouldn't be possible. The iron chain screams past, grazing air where your nose just was.
You didn't move. Something moved you.

A vermillion glow emanates from your chest. It was the protection talisman that forced the dodge that your body could never have performed otherwise, just as Lichen had commanded those phantoms before.
So it works on the living too? She really...
There's no time to dwell on it. While you are dodging, the coffin ghost has already shredded the dark arms. It pivots, coiling for another strike.
